label: COMMIT1 (before any new state is read)

readout.R: R1 (mean block output over code tokens, neutral-twin context, enable_thinking=False)
readout.distance: Euclidean kNN graph on raw float R1, symmetrised, components joined; Dijkstra geodesics
readout.placement: d(x, j) = min over x's k nearest frame points i of (||x - i|| + geo(i, j)) (E46 stage_analysis.oos)

frames.F0: iteration-9 PRIMARY M-code programs (cached states) + accepted top-ups; algorithm labels; classes >= 10 programs: bfs, dfs, iddfs, astar, gbfs, dijkstra_unit, idastar, bibfs
frames.F1: F0 + the 15 G1 factorial cells (PROBE excluded, placed instead); LEV_DEQ->bfs, DFS_STK->dfs, LEV_HEAP->dijkstra_unit, HEU_HEAP->astar/gbfs by key (+ in the first heap-key term), others factorial-other
frames.S_disc(f): F1 minus every program whose measured container is c_f (graph rebuilt)
frames.S_cont(f): F1 restricted to container c_f (graph rebuilt)
frames.F7_deviation: jps (1) and biastar (7) below 10 after 120 attempts each: F0 has 3 non-banned classes; the F1 mechanism median uses the RLX, RND, CRD cells plus the non-banned catalogue classes as references

g1.statistics: rho_d = partial Spearman(D, D_disc | D_cont); rho_c = partial Spearman(D, D_cont | D_disc); *_full add D_surf, D_len, D_disp; Kendall tau-a zero-order
g1.inference: B = 1000 bootstrap of programs within cells (graph rebuilt); restricted permutations exact (disc within container; cont within discipline); Holm over 2 models; noise ceiling 100 split-halves
g1.verdict: SUPPORTED if rho_d >= 0.3, Holm within-container p < 0.05 and P_boot(rho_d > rho_c) >= 0.95; DISCONFIRMED if rho_d <= 0.1 on both models; INTERMEDIATE otherwise; FRAGILE if full-control or cross-validated result flips the verdict
dropped_before_data: D_beh graded sensitivity (F5 drop order: dropped for time)

predictions.UD-LEV: EDGE on F0 and F1; nearest banned discipline LEV; EDGE on S_disc; Delta_UD > 0 (p < 0.05)
predictions.BF-RLX: OPPOSITE on F0 and F1; nearest S_cont cell RLX_ARR; Delta > 0
predictions.BF-LEV: 0 programs measured LEV -> the sharp discriminating test is unavailable (descriptive)
predictions.covert: >= 0.8 nearest banned on F0 and F1
predictions.descriptive: CK at CRD cells, RP/RC at RND, SP at LEV x SET (cell dropped, < 10), MX described

g2.verdict: SUPPORTED if UD, BF and covert predictions all hold; PARTIAL if UD or BF holds; DISCONFIRMED if UD OPPOSITE on S_disc (8B primary, 32B replication)
g2.family_class_rule: EDGE / OPPOSITE if > 50% of the family's programs are in that class, else MIXED

placebos: discipline labels shuffled across all cells (expect |rho_d| small, p > 0.05)
Gaussian random states with matched norms
t4_known_limitations: bootstrap percentile CI covered the across-dataset mean planted value in 0.56 of 50 runs (the within-cell bootstrap cannot see cell-structure variability; per-dataset population value not computed): P_boot criteria are read with this caveat; thresholds unchanged
